about.quote: Makeup is not a mask; it is the art of illuminating the royal goddess within you.
about.bioParagraph1: Welcome to the world of Arsh Khan — Delhi's acclaimed bridal makeup artist known for creating breathtaking, photogenic, and skin-like bridal transformations. Based in South Delhi (Pincode 110017) and serving the entirety of Delhi NCR and royal destination venues across India.
about.bioParagraph2: Arsh's signature technique blends modern global aesthetics with timeless Indian royal tradition. Every stroke is measured to enhance your unique facial architecture, ensuring your bridal glow remains immaculate under 4K video lights, tearful vidai moments, and late-night celebrations.

policy.title: STUDIO & BOOKING POLICIES
policy.subtitle: Please review our booking guidelines before scheduling your consultation.

items.title: 50% Advance Booking (Non-Refundable)
items.desc: A 50% non-refundable advance deposit is required to confirm and lock your wedding date in our calendar. Without an advance deposit, dates remain open to other inquiries.

items.title: 15-20 Days Prior Advance Booking
items.desc: Bridal dates during the peak wedding season fill up quickly. We strongly advise confirming your booking at least 15 to 20 days in advance to reserve your preferred artist slot.

items.title: Outstation Travel & Stay Extra
items.desc: For all destination or outstation weddings outside Delhi NCR, client arranges or reimburses round-trip travel tickets and secure hotel accommodations for the artist and assistant.

items.title: 100% Genuine Luxury Products
items.desc: We exclusively use top-tier genuine international brands: MAC, Huda Beauty, NARS, Bobbi Brown, Charlotte Tilbury, and Dior. We maintain strict hygiene and sanitize all brushes between clients.

reviews.title: Real Bride Love & 5-Star Reviews
reviews.subtitle: Unfiltered feedback from real Indian brides across South Delhi, NCR & Destination weddings.

items.name: Pooja Sharma
items.review: Booking Arsh for my wedding day was hands down the BEST decision of my wedding! From 6 PM varmala to 5 AM morning pheras, my makeup did not move even 1%! The HD finish was so skin-like, lightweight and natural—zero cakey feeling. Every single guest and my husband couldn't stop praising how royal yet natural I looked. Arsh was so punctual and patient during the pre-wedding rush. Thank you so much Arsh for making me feel like a true queen! 👑❤️

items.name: Dr. Simran Kaur
items.review: I am very particular about hygiene and genuine products because of my sensitive skin. Arsh only used fresh sanitized brushes and top-tier luxury brands like Charlotte Tilbury and Dior. The Airbrush base stayed completely sweat-proof and tear-proof throughout our emotional vidai ceremony. Her eye makeup and lashes blend so seamlessly. Highly recommended to every Delhi bride looking for understated royal elegance! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

items.name: Tanya Malhotra
items.review: Arsh did my cocktail evening glam and my mother’s party makeup. She gave me the most stunning Hollywood waves hairstyle and radiant glass-skin glow that looked magical under chandelier lighting. The outfit draping and jewelry setting were done to absolute perfection. 10/10 professionalism!

items.name: Ananya Singhal
items.review: Arsh created completely distinct vibes for all three of my functions! Fresh dewy sun-kissed for Haldi, floral braided chic for Mehndi, and high-fashion red carpet glam for Reception. What I loved most is how she listens to what YOU want instead of forcing typical heavy makeup. Worth every single rupee.

items.name: Rhea Sengupta
items.review: Hired Arsh for our destination wedding in Jaipur. She arrived right on time with her full professional kit and lighting setup. She handled me, my mother, and my sister effortlessly without any rush or stress. Her dupatta setting and matha patti pinning stayed rock solid even while dancing in the baraat! Total artist with golden hands.

items.name: Mehak Chawla
items.review: If you want your bridal photos and 4K wedding video to look flawless from every angle without looking overdone, book Arsh Khan without thinking twice! Her contouring and blush placement sculpted my face beautifully. She is super humble, polite, and reassuring on a bride's most anxious day.
